definitions.explanation: Expresses strong desire or recommendation. Used to strongly encourage someone or express earnest hope.

examples.japanese: ぜひ{食|た}べてみてください。
examples.english: You really should try eating this.

examples.japanese: ぜひ{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: I definitely want to go to Japan.

examples.japanese: {今度|こんど}の{週末|しゅうまつ}、ぜひ{遊|あそ}びに{来|き}てください。
examples.english: Please do come over to hang out this weekend.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}はとてもおもしろいので、ぜひ{読|よ}んでみてください。{人生|じんせい}が{変|か}わりますよ。
examples.english: This book is really interesting, so you should definitely read it. It will change your life.

notes: Can be written as {是非|ぜひ} in kanji but hiragana is more common. Adds emphasis and sincerity to requests, invitations, or expressions of desire. Often used when inviting someone or recommending something.
